audience: people who want small browser utilities
agents adding a new extension safely
problem: Small browser tools disappear into chats and downloaded ZIPs, while broad permissions, shared runtime assumptions, and unclear verification make simple utilities harder to trust.
solution: Keep each browser extension independently installable, local-first, narrowly permissioned, evidence-aware, and easy to package without coupling unrelated utilities into one product.
mechanism: registry metadata for inventory and status
policies for permissions, privacy, destructive actions, and selector drift

evidence.claim: Each extension is independently loadable and does not depend on sibling runtime directories.
The collection uses local-first privacy and least-privilege permission rules.
The collection has four registered extensions with deterministic test evidence and one live-smoke-required state.
GitHub Releases publish separate versioned ZIPs with checksums.

boundaries: This is a collection, not one monolithic extension.
Load one extension directory, never the repository root.
Do not add credentials, telemetry, CAPTCHA bypass, anti-detection, or access-control circumvention.
Deterministic tests do not prove live-site behavior.
Shared runtime code needs repeated demonstrated reuse.

preferred.verification: deterministic evidence plus live smoke when required
